text.p: The following are the main stories from Friday morning's German newspapers:
- Dramatic collapse in jobs market. Number of unemployed rises to 4.66 million. SPD demands turnaround in economic and financial policies of the government.
- Italian prime minister Romano Prodi says ahead of visit with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl that Italy on way to currency union. He rejects doubts about Italy's fitness for single currency.
- Wage dispute in publishing industry ends. Workers to get 1.5 percent pay raise from April 1.
- The strong dollar stands at centre of G7 meeting in Berlin
- New post-war record high for unemployment.
- Prodi says Italy's entry into EMU a certainty
- Unions say Kohl to blame for high unemployment
- CSU pushes for quick agreement on tax reform plans
- German rail's Bahncard to become more expensive from April
- CSU wants clarity over pension reform by March
- Waigel calls for reorganising social state
